name: Zebulun
overview: Zebulun is a male figure known as the tenth-born son of Jacob and the sixth son of Leah, belonging to the tribe of Zebulun. He holds a unique position as the last son Leah bore to Jacob, marking an important lineage within the Israelite tribes.
namesAndTitles: The name Zebulun means 'honor,' reflecting Leah's hope that Jacob would honor her for bearing six sons. This proper name is not given directly by God but is recorded in Genesis 30:20.
familyAndRelationships: Zebulun is explicitly identified as the son of Jacob and inferred as the son of Leah. He has multiple brothers and half-brothers, including Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Dinah as brothers, and Dan, Naphtali, Gad, Asher, Joseph, and Benjamin as half-brothers. He is also inferred to be the father of Sered.
scriptureSignificance: Zebulun’s significance lies in his role as the progenitor of the tribe of Zebulun, which was allocated a territory blessed with important trade routes. This tribe’s land included the region where Jesus grew up and began His ministry, linking Zebulun’s lineage to the unfolding of God’s redemptive plan through Christ. His birth and name symbolize Leah’s desire for honor within Jacob’s family structure.
